note: One maintenance record for every package-local copy of a governing shared source, as required by the skill authoring contract revision 2 'Per-skill structure and distribution'. Digests prove byte identity only; they establish nothing about semantic conformance, authorization, or acceptance.

derived_files.purpose: Checkpoint/transfer output template used by this package at runtime, so the installed skill does not depend on the framework docs tree being present.

source.selected_revision: operator-selected POC bytes at base commit c9298bd34ebb73bf598deec6253068d7f8b0ed59 with the operator's recorded working-tree modification; selected for this authoring assignment and preserved externally
source.preserved_store_root_note: The absolute root of the authority store is an operator-held value recorded in the authoring records for this candidate, deliberately not embedded here: a runtime resource must not hard-code a developer's home directory.

refresh_triggers: The governing shared handoff template changes and its owner selects that revision for this package.
The shared artifact contract changes the handoff envelope, the required inputs/outputs table, or the rule that an artifact never contains its own complete-byte digest.
The contributor-context specification changes the facts a checkpoint handoff must make recoverable.
An observed recovery or delivery failure in a recorded evaluation traces to this template copy.
derived_files.refresh_rule: Refresh only from the governing source at a revision its owner selected. Preserve governing meaning; a package-local copy may not amend the shared template. Refreshed bytes give this package a new identity and invalidate the affected prior evaluation.
derived_files.collision_rule: If this copy no longer matches its recorded destination_sha256, it was modified locally. Treat that as a collision: preserve the modified bytes, report the discrepancy to the package owner, and do not silently overwrite it during a refresh.

not_derived.evals/**: authored evaluation inputs; excluded from runtime distribution

limits.note: Recording a derivation is provenance, not evidence of expert behavior.
